scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src backend/test packages/core/src packages/core/test scripts
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/core && tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts backend/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run build -w packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p backend && tsc --noEmit -p frontend
